quant.rule: Minimize data copies prioritize SIMD parallelism for tensor operations.

bit.rule: Prioritize AVX2 intrinsics for quantized to floating-point conversions to maximize parallelism and reduce latency.

shard.rule: Maximize vector register usage for parallelism; align memory mappings to hardware page sizes.

hybrid.rule: Prioritize tensor compression over reallocation for OOM prevention.

kv.rule: Use quantized integers and AVX2 SIMD for tensor operations to enhance performance and reduce memory usage.

rope.rule: Batch process tensor operations using AVX2 SIMD to enhance performance and reduce memory access latency.

norm.rule: Maximize YMM register usage for SIMD parallelism, aligning tensor operations to cache lines.

fuse.rule: Minimize memory allocation, prioritize AVX2 instructions.

prune.rule: Prioritize non-zero element processing in SIMD for sparse matrices to enhance performance.

scale.rule: Adjust FP8 scale factors dynamically for optimal precision and performance balance.

scout.role: HF Hub Real-Time Model Discovery & Ranker
scout.rule: Maximize AVX2 register utilization by aligning memory access patterns to 256-bit boundaries.

tokenizer.rule: Optimize SIMD usage for parallelizable tasks; prioritize zero-copy mechanisms for data efficiency.

manifest.rule: Optimize tensor parsing by minimizing memory copies and utilizing SIMD registers for parallel processing.

fetch.rule: Always align tensor chunks to 64-byte boundaries for AVX2 and prefetch next chunk during current chunk CRC.

verify.rule: Optimize engine with parallelized AVX2 instructions.

matrix.rule: Optimize critical paths using AVX2 SIMD for maximum performance gains.

preset.rule: Utilize SIMD intrinsics for parallelizable operations to boost performance.

spec.rule: Minimize register spills via explicit YMM reservation before FastAPI marshalling.

mirror.role: Hugging Face Mirror & CDN Fallback Router
mirror.rule: Minimize data copying across language boundaries for performance gains.

profile.rule: Optimize cache locality and minimize memory allocation.
